rows.name: Customs: identifies missing documents
rows.expect: looks up the shipment and names the commercial invoice
rows.reply:
Your parcel is currently held at Roissy CDG customs due to a missing commercial invoice. 

To clear customs, we typically need a commercial invoice, proof of export, and your EORI number. I have requested a secure upload link to be sent to you for these documents (pending a quick human approval).

rows.name: Replies in the customer's language
rows.reply:
Ihr Paket SHIP-4521 hängt aktuell beim Zoll am Flughafen Roissy CDG fest (letzter Scan vor ca. 56 Stunden), da eine Handelsrechnung fehlt. 

Ich habe den Vorfall bereits an unsere Logistik-Operationen weitergeleitet. Wir kümmern uns um die Klärung mit dem Zoll!

rows.name: Hands off when asked for a human
rows.reply: I understand. I am transferring you to a human agent right now. Someone will be with you shortly!
